QuestInfo.name: Chasing Traces
QuestInfo.0: Agent N needs to speak with you.
QuestInfo.1: Contact the organization by collecting #b100 Traces of the Black Mage#k.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Traces of the Black Mage and delivered them to the organization.

0.0: Hey. I'm Agent N. I may look just like Agent M, but we have nothing in common! Got it?\r\n#L0##bUnderstood. If that is all, I've business to attend to. It was a pleasure to meet you.#l\n#k
0.1: Hey! Hey hey hey! I'm not done talking here! I've got some intel for you. It turns out most of the monsters in Maple World are under the Black Mage's influence!\r\n#L0##bHis reach has grown further than I thought.#l\n#k
0.2: This may be even worse than the alien invasion. But the Black Mage is your deal, right? Maybe you can find Traces of the Black Mage if you hunt monsters.

yes.0: If we can get 100 Traces of the Black Mage, our lab can do some hardcore analysis. Just hunt ordinary monsters around your level.

no.0: HEY! I'm trying to help, here!
